title: 🐛 Fix `status_code` being ignored for SSE and JSONL streaming endpoints
decision: Apply the same `_build_response_args()` path to the SSE and JSONL branches
why: SSE and JSONL streaming endpoints ignore declared and dependency-set status codes while raw streaming already handles both via `_build_response_args()`, and default behavior is unchanged because the temporary response starts with status_code = None
